output.rationale: The requirement specifies a test cabinet as part of a metal-clad switchgear system. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit matches the description as it offers arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the specification for the Syracuse Airport. This product is suitable for the engineered-to-order (ETO) offering type, as it can be tailored to include the required test cabinet and associated components.
